profile.headline: Senior iOS Engineer @CapitalOne
profile.summary: I’m a software engineer and outdoor enthusiast based in the roaring fork valley. I'm well versed in mobile architecture, app development and implementing server side logic. I have a decade of experience in mobile development, mentoring and shipping quality apps. In my free time I love backcountry hiking, skiing and jumping into alpine lakes!

positions.title: Mobile Developer - NBC Sports
positions.description:
• Designed, developed and tested native iOS, Android and Over The Top apps (Apple TV,
Fire TV, Chromecast and more)
• Provided instantaneous app updates by backend driven configurations
• Worked extensively with Swift, Objective-C, AVFoundation
• Worked with Urban Airship Push Notification services for handling client side notifications.
• Analytics development packages: Mixpanel, Kochava, Conviva and Adobe Heartbeat
• Rebuilt a native HLS media player into a Swift framework
• Rebuilt a clientless authentication flow using protocol oriented programming into a Swift
framework

positions.title: iOS Engineer
positions.description:
Independent consulting for iOS 

- Worked extensively with CoreLocation, AV Foundation and Auto Layout.
- Followed a work data flow principle for design and development.
- Worked closely within a cross functional team of testers and developers.
- Followed MVVM design patterns
- Integrated GraphQL in a native iOS app 
- Functional Reactive Programming with RxSwift

positions.title: iOS Engineer
positions.description:
- Create user interfaces and navigation layouts for a feature set within the main Citi iOS app.
- Implement all layers of the VIPER architecture for a new feature module
- Use micro services integrated with third party services for fetching account authentications 
- Mock API requests using XCTest and custom frameworks for unit testing.
- Work extensively with Swift, CoreGraphics and protocol oriented programming.
-Follow Test Driven Development principles.
